column1: # Romanian glossary. CLAUDE-ONLY PROPOSAL (2026-11-05): drafted alone by Claude, pending the three-vendor debate; not an approved term list, safety rows included.

# Same columns as en.tsv: term holds the Romanian, forms separated by " | ". Definitions are D3's where D3 changed them. The source column gives the evidence (Android ro, ro retailer usage, or judgment); reasons and links are in l10n/style/ro.md.

# Rows D3 retires stay, mapped to the chosen term, until D3 merges and en.tsv drops them. D3's new and renamed rows wait in l10n/pending/glossary-d3/ro.tsv until D3 merges (scratch/lang/glossary_hold.py restore ro). When D3 merges, also drop the acceleration-eco and acceleration-turbo rows, which D3 turns do-not-translate.

# HOLD until D3 merges: en.tsv and the strings still use Top speed and Maximum speed in their old senses, while the top-speed and maximum-speed rows below already use D3's. Following those rows now would call the setting Viteză de vârf and the measured value Viteză maximă, the swap section 7 of the style guide forbids.

# So do not draft or merge these keys before D3: dashboard_model_tile_top_speed, controls_experimental_speed_limit, the readings_maximum_speed_kmh ladder (with _short and _compact), and main_speed_* if they arrive first. They stay English (council verdict fallback). pack.py has no per-key filter, so a run over those areas must rule them out by hand. Other keys with these terms already match D3.
